tools.name: search_flower_offers
tools.description: Find real flower bouquets and potted plants for sale, from a description. Use this whenever the user asks for flowers in words: a flower type, colour, occasion, recipient, budget or delivery deadline (e.g. 'red roses under 40 EUR for tomorrow', 'something cheerful for a colleague'). Pass the request as `query` in any language; add structured fields when you know them. Also use it when the user shows a photo but match_bouquet_photo cannot receive the file: describe the flowers, colours and style you see and search with those. Returns ranked offers with price, shop, delivery time and links.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in their own words, any language (e.g. 'pink peonies for my mum's birthday'). Required.

flowers.description: Flower or plant types, any language (e.g. ["roses", "eucalyptus"]).

occasion.description: Occasion, e.g. birthday, thank you, wedding, anniversary.

recipient.description: Who the flowers are for, e.g. mother, colleague, partner.

style.description: Style, e.g. rustic, minimalist, romantic, wild meadow.

min_price_eur.description: Lower price limit in EUR. Hard filter.

max_price_eur.description: Upper price limit in EUR, inclusive. Hard filter.

max_delivery_days.description: Latest acceptable delivery, in days from today, for an address in Germany (1 = tomorrow). If the user names a date, convert it to days. Hard filter on the shop-stated delivery time.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 8, max 20).

tools.name: match_bouquet_photo
tools.description: Use this tool when the user provides a photo of a bouquet or flower arrangement and wants to find visually similar products available through Blumee. Identifies the flowers and colours in the photo (Pl@ntNet + vision model) and returns the closest real offers. Send the photo as image_file (attached file), image_url (public https) or image_base64 — exactly one. If you can see the photo but cannot pass it to this tool, call search_flower_offers with your own description instead. Takes ~5-15 s.

image_file.description: The photo the user attached (ChatGPT fills this automatically from the attachment).

image_url.description: Public https URL of the photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, max 8 MB).

image_base64.description: Base64 of the image file, for programmatic clients only (max 8 MB decoded).

max_price_eur.description: Upper price limit in EUR, inclusive. Hard filter.

max_delivery_days.description: Latest acceptable delivery, in days from today, for an address in Germany (1 = tomorrow). If the user names a date, convert it to days. Hard filter on the shop-stated delivery time.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 8, max 20).

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: List offers by exact attributes: flower, colour, occasion, shop, price range, delivery time, with sorting and paging. Use this to answer "what does shop X have", "cheapest tulips", or to page through everything matching a filter. The first call (no cursor) also returns available_values — the valid flower, colour, occasion and shop values. For free-form wishes use search_flower_offers.

flowers.description: German flower names exactly as listed in available_values.flowers (e.g. "Rose", "Tulpe").

colors.description: Colour values exactly as listed in available_values.colors.

occasions.description: Occasion keywords, e.g. "birthday", "valentines", "Geburtstag". Matched as substrings.

shops.description: Shop names exactly as listed in available_values.shops.

min_price_eur.description: Lower price limit in EUR. Hard filter.

max_price_eur.description: Upper price limit in EUR, inclusive. Hard filter.

max_delivery_days.description: Latest acceptable delivery, in days from today, for an address in Germany (1 = tomorrow). If the user names a date, convert it to days. Hard filter on the shop-stated delivery time.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 8, max 20).

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous browse_catalog call, for the next page.

tools.name: get_flower_offer
tools.description: Get full details of one offer by id: description, all images, size, species, delivery terms — and the same bouquet in other sizes or at other shops (same_bouquet_offers), for comparing prices. Use after a search when the user asks about a specific offer.

offer_id.description: Offer id (UUID) as returned by any Blumee search tool.
